Container.Name: music-bot
Container.Overview: Discord music bot that plays your own music library (Aurral's built-in Subsonic server, or Navidrome) in voice channels, in your server and your friends' servers. You approve each server from a Discord DM. Search-as-you-type /play, radio (random or songs like one you pick), lyrics, loop, seek, volume, queue controls and a live now-playing card. Optional Apex Legends stats: /apex link, stats, maps, Predator cutoff, a squad leaderboard and rank-up shout-outs. To reach Aurral by name (http://aurral:3001), put this container on the same custom Docker network; on plain bridge, use http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:PORT.
Container.Requires: A Discord bot token for a separate "music" application (see the README), and a login for the bot on Aurral (or another Subsonic server).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Small SQLite file: which servers are approved, each server's volume and now-playing board. Optional bot.env here fills in settings.

Config.Name: DISCORD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Discord — Discord Developer Portal → your music bot application → Bot → Reset Token.

Config.Name: OWNER_ID
Config.Description: Discord — Your own Discord user ID (who approves servers). Leave empty to use the application's owner. Discord → Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click yourself → Copy User ID.

Config.Name: ALLOWED_GUILD_IDS
Config.Description: Discord — Servers to approve without asking, comma separated (servers you own are approved anyway).

Config.Name: SUBSONIC_URL
Config.Description: Your music library — Aurral's address, the same one you open in the browser (e.g. http://aurral:3001). Any Subsonic server works too (Navidrome, gonic…).

Config.Name: SUBSONIC_USER
Config.Description: Your music library — A local Aurral account just for the bot (e.g. "discord"). Sign in to Aurral with it once in a browser.

Config.Name: SUBSONIC_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Your music library — That account's password (Aurral API keys don't work for this).

Config.Name: MUSIC_BITRATE
Config.Description: Your music library — Stream bitrate in kbps (Discord voice tops out around 128 on unboosted servers).

Config.Name: APEX_API_KEY
Config.Description: Apex Legends stats (optional) — Free key from apexlegendsapi.com. Leave empty to turn the /apex commands off.

Config.Name: APEX_POLL_MINUTES
Config.Description: Apex Legends stats (optional) — How often to check linked players' ranks for the leaderboard and shout-outs, in minutes.

Config.Name: TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Apex Legends stats (optional) — The leaderboard's week starts Monday at midnight in this time zone.

Config.Name: IDLE_MINUTES
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Leave the voice channel after this many minutes with nothing playing or nobody listening.

Config.Name: HEALTH_PORT
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — Port for the container's own health check (GET /healthz). Nothing needs to reach it.

Config.Name: HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — How long to wait for the music library to answer, in milliseconds.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Tuning (defaults are fine) — debug, info, warn or error.
